clips.title: The story
paras: Near the Grove of the Ancients, Wildbend River carries demonic poison toward the sea. Its tainted waters run through southern Darkshore from the corrupted heights of Felwood, endangering the wilderness.

Wildbend River brings corruption, not clean nourishment, to southern Darkshore. It flows west past the Grove of the Ancients and empties into the sea. The river continues from Felwood's Bloodvenom River, tumbling through rocky ridges with foul runoff. Night elves watch its banks for twisted wildlife and the spread of demonic blight.
